title: thalictrum expansum subsp. virgultorum
intro: Thalictrum expansum subsp. virgultorum, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a flowering plant belonging to the family Ranunculaceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Meadow Rue include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic, making it potentially useful in the treatment of conditions such as arthritis, allergies, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Meadow Rue include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
